jobs.description: As a Care Worker (Verzorgende IG) in Bladel, you will provide dedicated elderly care in a welcoming, small-scale residential setting with 21 apartments. You support residents with personal hygiene, dressing, mobility and other daily activities while encouraging them to remain as independent as possible.
